mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25pp over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly housing starts exceeding 1,300,000 units signal robust consumer demand for housing, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST > 1300.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales above their 12-month moving averages indicate strong consumer spending momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates below 3.5% signal tight labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins through wage growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and core inflation declines signal a successful 'soft landing' monetary policy, reducing equity volatility and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 0.5pp increase and CPIAUCSL < 0.2pp decrease in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS increases >0.5pp and CPIAUCSL decreases >0.2pp in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production above 106.0 (index 2017=100) indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 106.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
